  ✓ proved-locally refuse-invalid: Malformed, wrong-version, unknown, and off-route messages are refused before any handler runs, and change no state.

  ✓ proved-locally dedupe-input: A release seen again in a later poll is recorded once and notified once.
  ✓ proved-locally atomic-handler: A crash before or after a handler's writes leaves no partial state; the retry runs as if the first attempt never happened.
  ✓ proved-locally at-least-once: A message whose delivery failed survives the sender's eviction and is delivered by the alarm; actor state survives eviction.
  ✓ proved-locally dead-letter: A message that can't be delivered stops after 6 attempts and is recorded as retry.exhausted, not retried forever.
  ✓ proved-locally order-independent: Classification and the latest-version pointer don't depend on arrival order.
  ✓ proved-locally scheduled-wake: Watching a feed arms a 15-minute wake that re-arms itself; a wake with nothing to watch does nothing.
  ~ stub-only      notify-once-keyed: A notification the gateway accepted but didn't acknowledge reaches the owner once, because it is retried with the same key and the gateway deduplicates by key. Shown with a stub gateway; a real gateway must honor the key.
  · not-guaranteed exactly-once-notify: Exactly-once notification when a gateway ignores the idempotency key. (Retries after a lost acknowledgment can duplicate; only the gateway's deduplication prevents it.)
  · not-guaranteed exact-schedule: Polls exactly every 15 minutes. (Durable Object alarms run at least once and can be delayed by up to a minute.)
  · not-guaranteed production-traces: Traces of production traffic in actors trace. (actors trace reads local test and dev events only; production events go to Workers Logs.)
